1.s: The court states the RPD received the Applicant's reopening application on December 13, 2019, after an October 31, 2019 abandonment decision.

10.s: The earlier decision-maker found the Notice was returned undelivered on November 25, 2019.

11.s: The earlier decision-maker found the Notice was forwarded to the new address on November 27, 2019.

12.s: The court states the Board received the reopening application on December 13, 2019.

13.s: The applicant's counsel argues the BOC was submitted on time on October 13, 2019, supported by a fax copy.

14.s: The court notes the fax receipt attached is dated December 12, 2019, addressed to the Ministère de la sécurité publique du Canada.

15.s: The court notes the BOCs were signed October 13, 2019 but date-stamped by the Board on December 13, 2019.

16.s: The earlier decision-maker found the Board processed the BOCs on December 19, 2019.

17.s: The court finds no evidence supports counsel's claim that the BOCs were received on October 13, 2019.

18.s: The court finds the BOCs were signed October 13, 2019 but provided to the Board on December 13, 2019.

19.s: The court finds the fax shows BOCs sent to Ministère de la sécurité publique du Canada but not to the Board.

2.s: The court explains the RPD can only reopen claims if a natural justice breach is shown.

20.s: The court finds the fax receipt and BOC dates conflict, indicating the BOCs were not attached to the fax.

21.s: The tribunal asked the Applicant to prove forwarding the reopening application to the Minister as required by RPD Rule 62(2).

22.s: The Applicant provided a December 12, 2019 fax receipt to the Ministère de la sécurité publique du Canada showing 26 pages were sent.

23.s: The tribunal finds the Applicant failed to comply with Rule 62(2) and may have tried to mislead the Tribunal.

24.s: The tribunal finds no breach of natural justice principles was established here.

25.s: The tribunal denies the Applicant's application to reopen the claim after full consideration.

3.s: The earlier decision-maker found the claim was referred to the IRB on October 4, 2019.

4.s: The earlier decision-maker found the Applicant was given 15 days to submit the BOC or face a special hearing on October 28, 2019.

5.s: The earlier decision-maker found the Applicant did not appear at the October 28, 2019 special hearing.

6.s: The earlier decision-maker found counsel also failed to appear at the special hearing.

7.s: The earlier decision-maker found the claim was abandoned on October 28, 2019 due to Applicant's default.

8.s: The earlier decision-maker found the Notice of Abandonment was sent to the Applicant on October 30, 2019.

9.s: The earlier decision-maker found the Applicant notified the Board of a new address on November 4, 2019.
